home.title: Real Estate Brokers Register
home.lead: The official register of licensed real-estate brokers in the Arab Republic of Egypt, operated by the General Organization for Export & Import Control.
home.verifyLead: Enter a registration number to confirm whether a broker is registered, for what types, which category, and until when.
home.signInLead: For Authority employees and registered entities.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Sign in with your email address and password.
signIn.failedTitle: You could not be signed in.
signIn.failedWhy: The email address or password is incorrect, or the account has not been activated yet.
signIn.failedNext: Check the email address and password. If your account was created recently, open the activation link sent to your email first.
signIn.failedWho: If this continues, contact the system administrator at the Authority.
signIn.suspendedWhy: A system administrator suspended this account, so it cannot be used to sign in.
signIn.suspendedNext: There is no action you can take from here.
signIn.suspendedWho: Contact the system administrator at the Authority to find out why.

activate.title: Activate your account
activate.lead: Choose your own password. Nobody else will know it, including the administrator who created the account.
activate.successLead: You can now sign in with the password you chose.
activate.mismatchWhy: The two passwords do not match.
activate.mismatchNext: Enter the same password in both fields.
activate.mismatchWho: If this keeps happening, contact the system administrator at the Authority.
activate.tooShortWhy: The password is shorter than 12 characters.
activate.tooShortNext: Choose a password of at least 12 characters.
activate.invalidTitle: This activation link is not valid.
activate.invalidWhy: The link has expired or has already been used.
activate.invalidNext: Ask the system administrator to send a new activation link.
activate.invalidWho: The system administrator at the Authority.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.lead: Create and suspend accounts for Authority employees. Broker accounts self-register and are not managed here.
accounts.noCaseAccess: A system administrator sees no application, registration, or supervisory data. Administration is not access.
accounts.name: Name in English
accounts.create: Create account and send activation link
accounts.createdTitle: Account created and activation link sent.
accounts.createdLead: An activation link was emailed to {email}. The employee sets their own password.
accounts.emptyLead: Create the first government account from the form beside this. Officials cannot register themselves.
accounts.failedNext: Correct the details and try again.
accounts.failedWho: If the address is already registered, suspend or reactivate the existing account instead — accounts are never deleted.
accounts.createdNext: The activation message has been sent. The holder cannot sign in until they set a password.
accounts.reasonHint: Recorded in the audit trail against your name. State why, not what.
accounts.linkTitle: Hand this link to the employee yourself.
accounts.linkLead: This deployment has no outbound mail, so nothing was emailed. Give this link to the employee by a channel you trust. It lets them set their own password — treat it as a credential.
accounts.linkOnce: Shown once. Issue a new one if it is lost — that cancels this one.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.lead: An append-only, hash-chained record of every event. Read access is recorded as well as changes.
audit.emptyLead: Every state change is recorded here automatically, and cannot be edited or removed once written.
audit.countLabel: Showing the most recent {shown} of {total} events.
audit.chainIntactLead: Every event hashes to its recorded value and links to its predecessor. Events checked: {count}.
audit.chainBrokenLead: The chain could not be verified. Report this to the system administrator immediately and do not rely on this trail until it has been reviewed.
audit.chainScopeWindow: Only the events on this page were checked, anchored to the event immediately before them. The full chain is verified by the scheduled sweep.
audit.chainScopeFull: The whole chain was verified, from the first event.

dashboard.phaseNote: Registration runs end to end, from the application to an issued card. The brokers register, the appointment diary, and supervisory signals are in service alongside it.
dashboard.phaseLead: What is ready at this stage, and what follows it.
dashboard.noActions: No actions are available to your role at this stage.
dashboard.noActionsLead: Your role is registered and active, but the screens belonging to it are built in a later phase. Nothing is required of you now.

common.notAuthorisedTitle: You do not have access to this page.
common.notAuthorisedWhy: Your current role ({role}) does not include this screen.
common.notAuthorisedWho: If you need this access, contact the system administrator at the Authority.
common.errorTitle: This page could not be shown.
common.errorWhy: An unexpected fault occurred while preparing the page. Nothing was saved.
common.errorNext: Try again. If it keeps happening, copy the reference below and send it on.
common.errorWho: Contact Authority technical support, quoting the fault reference.
common.notFoundWhy: The address you opened does not point to a page in this system.
common.notFoundNext: Check the address, or return to the dashboard.
common.notFoundWho: If this link came to you from the Authority, tell the sender.

portal.title: My applications
portal.lead: Your firm's registration applications, and where each one stands.
portal.emptyTitle: You have not started an application yet
portal.emptyLead: Registration in the Real Estate Brokers Register is a condition of practising. The application is broken into short steps and saves as you go, so you can stop and come back whenever you need to.
portal.registrationLead: Your entry in the register, and your registration card.
portal.noRegistrationLead: The registration card is issued once the Authority approves the application and the fees are recorded.
portal.whatHappensNextLead: The application passes through the Authority's officers in this order, and its progress appears on this page.
portal.helpLead: Have these papers beside you — you can photograph them with your phone camera:
portal.helpTime: You can stop at any step and return later; nothing you have entered is lost.
portal.helpNoPayment: You are never asked to pay anything on this site. Fees are paid at the Authority and recorded there.
portal.obligationNumber: The registration number must appear on all your papers, correspondence, and advertisements.
portal.obligationRenewalAfter: , which is {days} days before it expires.
portal.obligationNotify: Any change to the firm’s data or to a registered brokerage contract must be notified within thirty days.

whatNext.DRAFT: This application is still with you and has not reached the Authority. Finish the outstanding steps, then press Submit on the review step. Everything you enter is saved, and you can come back at any time.
whatNext.SUBMITTED: It has reached the Authority and is waiting to be booked in. When it is, a temporary application number appears at the top of this card. Nothing is needed from you now.
whatNext.UNDER_INTAKE: The registry clerk is booking the file in, allocating its temporary number, and assigning it to an examiner. Nothing is needed from you now.
whatNext.UNDER_EXAMINATION: An examiner is checking your details and documents item by item. If anything is missing you will receive a completion request and the application will reopen for you to correct it. Nothing is needed from you now.
whatNext.AWAITING_COMPLETION: The Authority has asked you to complete specific items. The application is open to you again — correct what is asked for, then resubmit from the review step. Examination does not resume until you resubmit.
whatNext.UNDER_REVIEW: The file is with the reviewer, who is a different official from the one who examined it. The decision to approve or refuse is theirs. Nothing is needed from you now.
whatNext.APPROVED: The application has been approved. Next come the fees and then the card. The issuance status will appear here as it changes.
whatNext.REJECTED: The application was refused, and the reason is recorded inside it. Read the reason, then contact the Authority if you have something to put to them.
whatNext.AWAITING_PAYMENT: Fees have been recorded and the file is waiting for the card to be issued.
whatNext.CARD_ISSUED: The card has been issued and is waiting to be handed over. Your permanent registration number appears on the "My registration" page once it has been.
whatNext.ACTIVE: The registration is in force. The permanent registration number and the card are on the "My registration" page, and the number must appear on everything you issue.
whatNext.WITHDRAWN: This application was withdrawn and is no longer under consideration. You may start a new one.

apply.title: Application to register in the Real Estate Brokers Register
apply.autoSaved: Everything you enter is saved at each step, and you can come back at any time.
apply.digitsOnlyHint: Digits and separators only — e.g. 12345 or 2026/1234. Letters are not accepted.
apply.reviewGapsTitle: Still required before you can submit
apply.reviewGapsLead: Select any item to go straight to it.
apply.readyLead: Check the details below, then send it to the Authority. After submission you cannot edit it unless the Authority asks for a completion.
apply.submittedTitle: Your application has reached the Authority
apply.submittedLead: It will be entered in the incoming register under a temporary number, then passed for examination.
apply.withdrawConfirm: Withdrawing stops the application being considered. It is not deleted, and it stays on the record.
apply.capacityTitle: In what capacity are you applying?
apply.capacityLead: This choice determines the rest of the steps and which documents are asked of you.
apply.nationalIdOnFile: A national ID is already recorded on this application. Enter it again to confirm — the stored number is never shown on screen.
apply.whyCapacity: The capacity determines who signs the declarations and where responsibility lies. It is required by the Authority's application form.
apply.whyNationalId: The national ID is used to verify the applicant's identity. It is one of the customer due diligence details the supervisory authority is required to hold.
apply.poaLead: Because you are applying as an agent, we need the notarised power of attorney and a declaration that it remains in force.
apply.poaDeclareValid: I declare that this power of attorney remains in force and has not been revoked.
apply.poaDeclarePrincipalAlive: I declare that the principal is alive as at the date of this declaration.
apply.whyPoa: The power of attorney is recorded by its number, year, and notarisation office together, so the Authority can verify it and can detect the same instrument being used across unrelated applications.
apply.entityLead: Copy these from the commercial register extract and the tax card.
apply.headOfficeAddress: Head office or premises where the activity is practised
apply.commercialRegisterDate: Date of entry in the commercial register
apply.whyTradeName: The trade name is what the broker is registered under and what anyone verifying the registration will see, so it must match the commercial register exactly.
apply.whyTradeStyle: The trade style may differ from the trade name, and the Authority's form asks for both.
apply.whyCommercialRegister: The issuing office and the date identify exactly which extract you are referring to, which is what the examiner has in front of them.
apply.whyTax: The tax card is one of the customer due diligence documents, and the tax office allows it to be verified.
apply.categoryLead: Choose the brokerage work you will practise, then the category your paid-up capital supports.
apply.typesLead: You may register in more than one type.
apply.categoryUnavailable: Your current capital does not support this
apply.categoryEnterCapitalFirst: Enter the paid-up capital to see which categories are open to you.
apply.whyCategory: The category sets the highest contract value you may broker, and each category has a minimum paid-up capital under Ministerial Decree 578 of 2025.
apply.whyTypes: The registration type determines what work you may carry out; a contract recorded under a type you are not registered for is refused.
apply.contractsLead: Enter the brokerage contract you are registering. You may add more than one.
apply.contractsEmptyLead: The Authority's form requires the details of at least one brokerage contract with the registration application.
apply.capacityActedIn: Capacity acted in under this contract
apply.subjectDescription: Description of the project or unit being brokered
apply.subjectAddress: Address of the project or unit
apply.whyClientNames: The client's name is recorded in both Arabic and Latin script, because the register is searched in both, and a name held in one script does not appear to somebody searching in the other.
apply.whyAuthentication: The authentication number from the Real Estate Publicity Authority, an embassy, or a consulate is what ties the contract to an official record that can be checked.
apply.removeContractConfirm: The contract is not deleted from the record; it is removed from this application.
apply.documentsLead: Photograph each document with your phone camera, or upload a file. The image is shown back to you afterwards so you can check it is legible.
apply.versionNote: Version {n} — earlier versions are retained and never deleted.
apply.whyDocuments: These documents are required by the Authority's form and by the customer due diligence procedures. The examiner checks them one by one against the details you entered.
apply.declarationsLead: Fifteen declarations, each binding in its own right. Affirm each one after reading it.
apply.declarationsWarning: These are legally binding declarations, and making a false declaration carries liability.
apply.decl10NotEmployee: I am not a government or public-sector employee.
apply.decl10IsEmployee: I work for a government or public-sector body; I identify it and consent to its being notified.
apply.reviewLead: This is what will reach the Authority. Check it before you submit.
apply.completionsLead: Deal with each item below, then send the application back.
apply.resubmit: Send the application back to the Authority
apply.timelineLead: Every step it has passed through, who performed it, and when.
apply.capitalBelowChosen: The capital entered does not reach the minimum for {category}, which is {minimum}.
apply.highestCategoryAvailable: The highest category this capital supports is {category} — {band}.
apply.docHelpToggle: What is this document, and why is it asked for?
apply.docHelpMissing: What if I do not have it?

IDENTITY_DOC_APPLICANT.what: A clear copy of the identity document of the person signing this application — national ID card, passport, refugee travel document, or military card.
IDENTITY_DOC_APPLICANT.why: The registration is issued to a named person, and the Authority must verify who the applicant is before registering them, not afterwards.
IDENTITY_DOC_APPLICANT.upload: Photograph the whole face of the document so that all four corners, the photograph and the number are visible. For a two-sided card, use the side carrying the national ID number.
IDENTITY_DOC_APPLICANT.missing: The application cannot be submitted without it. If your document has expired, renew it first.

COMMERCIAL_REGISTER_EXTRACT.what: A valid official extract from the firm's entry in the Commercial Register, or a document proving registration with the competent administrative body.
COMMERCIAL_REGISTER_EXTRACT.why: It is what proves the firm exists in law and that its registered activity permits real-estate brokerage. The examiner checks the register number and issuing office you entered at step 2 against this extract.
COMMERCIAL_REGISTER_EXTRACT.upload: The complete extract, all pages, showing the register number, the issuing office and the last renewal date.
COMMERCIAL_REGISTER_EXTRACT.missing: The application cannot be submitted without it. Obtain it from the Commercial Register office covering your head office.

TAX_REGISTRATION_CARD.what: The firm's tax registration card, showing the tax registration number and the competent tax office.
TAX_REGISTRATION_CARD.why: The number and the office are two separate items on the registration form, and the Authority needs both — not the number alone.
TAX_REGISTRATION_CARD.upload: A copy of the whole card. Check that the tax number and the office name are legible before sending.
TAX_REGISTRATION_CARD.missing: The application cannot be submitted without it. It is issued by the Egyptian Tax Authority.

PROOF_OF_PAID_UP_CAPITAL.what: A document evidencing the paid-up capital you are relying on for the category you are requesting — a bank certificate, or its equivalent in the incorporation papers.
PROOF_OF_PAID_UP_CAPITAL.why: Each category carries a minimum paid-up capital. The system compares the figure you entered at the "Type and category" step against the floor for the category you asked for, and refuses the submission if it falls short.
PROOF_OF_PAID_UP_CAPITAL.upload: The document that states the amount explicitly, in Egyptian pounds. The figure must match what you entered at the "Type and category" step.
PROOF_OF_PAID_UP_CAPITAL.missing: The application cannot be submitted without it. If your capital does not reach the floor for the category you want, go back to "Type and category" and choose a lower one.

PREMISES_PROOF.what: A lease or title document for the premises at which the activity is practised.
PREMISES_PROOF.why: A registration is tied to a known address; inspections and official correspondence go there.
PREMISES_PROOF.upload: The complete document, showing the address and the period it covers. The address must match what you entered at the "The firm" step.
PREMISES_PROOF.missing: The application cannot be submitted without it.

CRIMINAL_RECORD_EXTRACT.what: A criminal record extract for the applicant.
CRIMINAL_RECORD_EXTRACT.why: It is the document behind the declaration you will sign at the "Declarations" step about not having been convicted of an offence against honour or trust. The declaration on its own is not enough.
CRIMINAL_RECORD_EXTRACT.upload: A recently issued extract, with the date of issue visible.
CRIMINAL_RECORD_EXTRACT.missing: The application cannot be submitted without it. It is obtained from a police station or a notarisation office.

ARTICLES_OF_ASSOCIATION.what: The company's memorandum and articles of association, or the official gazette in which they were published, together with any published amendments.
ARTICLES_OF_ASSOCIATION.why: It is the document that fixes the company's form, its objects, and who may represent it. The examiner checks it against the legal form you entered.
ARTICLES_OF_ASSOCIATION.upload: The complete document as a PDF, with amendments if there are any.
ARTICLES_OF_ASSOCIATION.missing: An application in the name of a legal person cannot be submitted without it. It is not asked of a sole establishment.

REPRESENTATION_AUTHORISATION.what: Evidence that the natural person representing the company before the Authority is authorised to do so — a board resolution, or a notarised authorisation.
REPRESENTATION_AUTHORISATION.why: A company does not sign for itself. The Authority needs proof that whoever signed this application was entitled to sign it.
REPRESENTATION_AUTHORISATION.upload: The resolution or authorisation, showing the name of the authorised person, their capacity, and the scope of the authority given.
REPRESENTATION_AUTHORISATION.missing: An application in the name of a legal person cannot be submitted without it.

BENEFICIAL_OWNER_IDENTITY_DOCS.what: Identity documents of the natural persons holding controlling stakes of 25% or more; failing that, of natural persons controlling by other means; failing both, of the chairman or equivalent.
BENEFICIAL_OWNER_IDENTITY_DOCS.why: That sequence is how a beneficial owner is identified under the customer due-diligence procedures. The point is that behind every registered company there is a known natural person.
BENEFICIAL_OWNER_IDENTITY_DOCS.upload: One file gathering the identity documents of everyone who meets the description above.
BENEFICIAL_OWNER_IDENTITY_DOCS.missing: An application in the name of a legal person cannot be submitted without it. If nobody reaches 25%, upload the identity document of whoever actually controls the company; failing that, of the chairman.

SIGNATURE_SPECIMENS.what: Specimen signatures of the persons authorised to deal in the company's name.
SIGNATURE_SPECIMENS.why: So that the Authority can verify a signature on anything the company sends it later.
SIGNATURE_SPECIMENS.upload: The specimen form certified by the company or by its bank.
SIGNATURE_SPECIMENS.missing: An application in the name of a legal person cannot be submitted without it.

PRELIMINARY_CONTRACT_UNDER_FORMATION.what: The preliminary contract signed by the founders showing each one's share, together with the founders' agent's power of attorney.
PRELIMINARY_CONTRACT_UNDER_FORMATION.why: A company still under formation has no final contract yet, and the preliminary contract is what evidences who founded it and in what shares.
PRELIMINARY_CONTRACT_UNDER_FORMATION.upload: The preliminary contract and the power of attorney in one PDF.
PRELIMINARY_CONTRACT_UNDER_FORMATION.missing: This item is optional and is only asked for where the company is still under formation. Leave it if your company is already incorporated.

OWNER_IDENTITY_DOC.what: The identity document of the sole establishment's owner.
OWNER_IDENTITY_DOC.why: In a sole establishment there is no separation between the firm and its owner, so their identity is the firm's identity as far as the register is concerned.
OWNER_IDENTITY_DOC.upload: A clear copy of the national ID card or passport.
OWNER_IDENTITY_DOC.missing: An application in the name of a sole establishment cannot be submitted without it.

POWER_OF_ATTORNEY.what: The notarised power of attorney authorising you to file this application on someone else's behalf.
POWER_OF_ATTORNEY.why: Only asked for if you chose at step 1 that you are applying as an agent under a power of attorney. Its number, year and notarisation office are recorded separately so that the same instrument being used across unrelated applications becomes visible.
POWER_OF_ATTORNEY.upload: The complete notarised instrument, showing its number, its year, the notarisation office, and the scope of the authority given.
POWER_OF_ATTORNEY.missing: If you are not an agent this item is not required in your case and is shown as optional. If you are, the application cannot be submitted without it.

gov.queueEmptyLead: Your queue is clear. Applications appear here as soon as they reach your step.
gov.intakeLead: Enter incoming applications in the register under a temporary number, then pass them for examination.
gov.intakeRecord: Enter in the register and assign a temporary number
gov.intakeAssignLead: Assignment is recorded against whoever made it; an examiner does not choose their own files.
gov.examinationLead: Check the documents against the details, complete the internal review form, and request completions where anything is missing.
gov.examinationFormLead: Check each line against the attached document, and mark it once confirmed.
gov.noEvidenceDocument: No single document answers this line.
gov.completionsLead: Each completion is a separate item with its own reason. A completion request in free text alone, without naming the item, is not accepted.
gov.completionChecklistItem: The item required, from the document checklist
gov.completionChecklistNone: Does not correspond to a checklist item
gov.completionDescriptionAr: What is required of the applicant
gov.requestCompletions: Send the completions to the applicant
gov.reviewLead: The final check and the decision. An examiner may not review an application they examined themselves.
gov.rejectReasonHint: A refusal requires a written reason, and its text reaches the applicant.
gov.sodNoticeLead: Applications you examined yourself do not appear in your queue, and the system refuses your decision on them even if one is opened directly.
gov.feesLead: Record the fees paid. The system records and does not collect; payment is made at the Authority's treasury.
gov.feesNoTariffNotice: The legal reference states no tariff for these headings, so the amounts are entered exactly as they appear on the treasury receipt.
gov.issuanceLead: Issue the registration card under a permanent registration number, then deliver it and enter it in the delivery ledger.
gov.deliveryLead: Enter the delivery in the ledger under a serial number, with the recipient's acknowledgement.
gov.ackRenewal: The recipient acknowledged the renewal date.
gov.ackNumberObligation: The recipient acknowledged the obligation to state the registration number on all papers and correspondence.
gov.recordsLead: Extract and record the file's data, then pass it to the archive.
gov.archiveLead: Receive the file with its page count and enter it in the serial and alphabetical registers.
gov.pageCountMismatch: The page count received at the archive differs from the count the registry clerk recorded ({intake} pages).
gov.eventTrailLead: Every hand the file passed through, in order, with its timestamp.
gov.intakeRecordedPages: The registry clerk recorded {intake} pages at the counter. Count again and enter what actually reached the archive.
gov.completionRequiredHint: A separate sentence from the problem. "The scan is illegible" describes what is wrong; "rescan the first page at a higher resolution" says what to do. Leaving this out is the commonest reason an item comes back a second time.
gov.completionLegalReferenceHint: The requirement or decree article the item rests on, where there is one. Items with no basis are counted by the process-integrity signals.
gov.queueSearchHint: Searches the trade name in Arabic and English, and the temporary reference number.
gov.queueNoMatchTitle: No file in this queue matches
gov.queueNoMatchLead: Change the search terms, or clear the search to see the whole queue.

verify.verifiedLead: This number belongs to an entity currently entered in the Real Estate Brokers Register.
verify.unverifiedLead: This number does not correspond to a registration that is valid today. It may never have been issued, or it may no longer be in force.
verify.scopeVerified: This confirms entry in the register on today’s date. It is not an endorsement of the entity’s conduct, and it says nothing about any individual transaction.
verify.scopeUnverified: Check the number as it is written on the entity’s correspondence — it takes the form 2026/0001. If it is written exactly as shown and still does not verify, the entity is not currently registered, and dealing with it as a broker is at your own risk.

returns.returnedTitle: Your application has been returned for correction
returns.returnedLead: The examiner has reviewed your application and identified {count} item(s) to put right before the examination can continue. Each one is listed below with what is wrong and what is needed.
returns.notARefusal: This is not a refusal. Your file and its documents are held exactly as they stand, and it returns to the same examiner as soon as you resubmit.
returns.withAuthorityLead: {count} item(s) are still recorded against this file. The file is with the Authority and nothing is required from you.
returns.allDoneTitle: Every item has been dealt with
returns.allDoneLead: {count} requested item(s) on this file have been dealt with. Nothing is required from you now.
returns.outstandingLead: Grouped by where each item sits in the application, so you can deal with a whole step at once.
returns.howToFix: Open the step the item belongs to, change the data or upload the replacement document, then resubmit from the review page. Nothing is deleted — the old document is kept and superseded by the new one.
returns.historyLead: Every item ever raised on this file, by round. Nothing is removed.
returns.neverReturned: This application has never been returned for correction.
returns.returnedLeadFaultOnly: The examiner has reviewed your application and identified {count} item(s) to put right before the examination can continue. Each one is listed below with what is wrong.

appointments.title: Your appointment
appointments.lead: Book a time to attend the Authority.
appointments.pickLead: These are all the periods offered over the coming weeks. Full and closed periods are shown too, so you can see you are looking at the whole diary.
appointments.chooseFirst: Choose a period above to complete the booking.
appointments.noneOpenTitle: No appointments are open at the moment
appointments.noneOpenLead: The Authority has not published times for this step yet. Try again in a few days, or contact the Central Administration for Commercial Registrations.
appointments.notDueLead: Appointments are booked at two points only: handing over the original documents after you submit, and collecting the card after approval and payment. You will be emailed when either falls due.
appointments.attendeePhoneHint: Used only if the Authority has to move the appointment.
appointments.commitmentTitle: Booking is a commitment to attend
appointments.commitmentLead: The period you take is not offered to anybody else. If you cannot come, cancel from this page and it returns to the diary — cancelling has no effect on your application.
appointments.bookedLead: Keep these details, or print them and bring them with you.
appointments.bringWhatLead: The originals of the documents you uploaded, your national ID card, and the power of attorney if you are attending as an agent.
appointments.cancelReasonHint: One line is enough. The Authority uses it to size the counter; it has no effect on your application.
appointments.historyLead: Every appointment booked on this application, including cancelled ones and ones not attended.
appointments.scheduleLead: Who is expected today, and who came.
appointments.scheduleEmptyLead: Nothing is booked for this date. Open new periods below if the counter is available.
appointments.attendanceNote: Attendance is a fact recorded on the file. Nothing follows from a non-attendance: neither Decree 578 nor the AML Controls attach a consequence to it, and this system invents none.
appointments.openSlotsLead: Give a day, a range of hours, a period length, and a capacity; the system expands them. Running this twice for the same day does not double the places.
appointments.expectedCount: {count, plural, =0 {No appointments on this day} one {# appointment} other {# appointments}}
appointments.periodsLead: The periods open on this day, and how many places in each are taken.
appointments.periodsEmptyTitle: No periods are open on this day
appointments.periodsEmptyLead: No broker can book on this date until periods are opened below.

register.title: The Brokers Register
register.lead: Registered brokers and the standing of each, soonest to expire first.
register.searchHint: Searches the trade name in Arabic and English, the trade style, and the registration number.
register.emptyLead: Change the search terms, or clear the filters to see the whole register.

supervision.title: Integrity signals
supervision.lead: What the system has noticed and put in front of a person.
supervision.notAnAccusationTitle: A signal is not an accusation
supervision.notAnAccusationLead: A signal is triage, not a finding and not evidence. Nothing follows from it automatically — no refusal, no sanction, no restriction. Its purpose is that a person looks and decides.
supervision.notAnAccusationSecond: Dismissing a signal requires a written reason, and escalating one opens a case. Both are written to the audit trail under the name of whoever did it.
supervision.basisLegal: A legal threshold — drawn from a decree or a statute, and held in the rule set that encodes it.
supervision.basisOperational: An operational parameter the Authority sets for triage — not a legal threshold, and must not be cited as one.
supervision.reasonHint: What you checked, and what you found. This is what makes your decision reviewable years later, and it is required — a signal cannot be closed without it.
supervision.emptyLead: Nothing has been raised under these filters. Try widening them, or look at the closed signals.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.lead: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sentTitle: If that account exists, the link has been sent.
forgotPassword.sentLead: Open your email and follow the link to choose a new password. The link works once and expires. We do not confirm whether an address is registered, to protect the privacy of account holders.
forgotPassword.unreachableTitle: The request could not be sent.
forgotPassword.unreachableLead: The request did not reach the server. Check your connection and try again. If this continues, contact the system administrator at the Authority.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.lead: Choose a new password for your account. Nobody else will know it, including the system administrator.
resetPassword.successLead: You can now sign in with your new password.
resetPassword.mismatchTitle: The password could not be changed.
resetPassword.invalidTitle: This reset link is not valid.
resetPassword.invalidWhy: The link has expired or has already been used. Reset links work only once.
resetPassword.invalidNext: Request a new link from the reset password page.
resetPassword.invalidWho: If this keeps happening, contact the system administrator at the Authority.

signUp.title: Open a broker account
signUp.lead: Register your brokerage firm with the Real Estate Brokers Register. You will confirm your email address before you can sign in.
signUp.emailHint: The Authority writes to this address. Use one the firm will keep.
signUp.sentLead: A confirmation message has been sent to the address below. Open the link in it, then sign in. The account cannot be used until the address is confirmed.
signUp.devLinkLead: This deployment has no mail provider, so the confirmation link is shown here. It is never shown in production.
signUp.refusedLead: An account already exists for that address, or too many accounts have been opened from this connection. Sign in instead, or reset the password.
